player_facing.title: Game Difficulty
player_facing.prompt: Choose the pace of your next job.

options.label: Easy
options.description: Smaller groups arrive in a fixed order, with more time between encounters.

options.label: Normal
options.description: A steady challenge with changing enemy groups, entrances and timing.

options.label: Hard
options.description: More overlapping threats and tougher enemy combinations leave less room for mistakes.

player_facing.retry_note: After a death, encounters restart from your respawn point. New runs vary encounters on Normal and Hard.

copy_contract: Descriptions depend on Mechanics implementing the stated differences; do not display unimplemented promises.
Avoid random seed, spawn budget, HP multipliers and other implementation terminology in the menu.
No shame, competence judgment or jokes targeting Easy players; do not equate difficulty with hero personality.
Keep enemy health and weapon damage unchanged initially; difficulty copy describes encounter pressure.
Retry note is optional secondary help, not required permanent screen clutter. It concerns arrangement, not dead-enemy persistence.
Enemy reset from respawn point onward is a separate rule; do not promise that defeated enemies remain absent.
Remaining-life respawns retain the resolved encounter arrangement. Game Over Retry starts a full new run and may select a new arrangement; never describe that button as retaining the old encounters.

flow.recommended: Start Game -> Hero -> Difficulty -> existing introduction/play
flow.back: Return to hero selection preserving the selected hero.
flow.intro: Preserve existing fresh-game introduction, skip and input-release guards; retry does not replay it.

art_opinion.approved_direction: Hard-mode heroes with exaggerated bigger muscles and torn workclothes; preserve trousers, recognizable trade gear and established Tony/Sean identities.
art_opinion.approval: Sean explicitly selected torn workclothes and bigger muscles over nudity on 2026-10-17, relayed by Game Mechanics.
art_opinion.rejected_alternative: Nudity with a black censor bar.
